text:
alex: running seq/batch sweep on L40S/A100 to validate hybrid-tiling selector. saw a reproducible p99 spike on L40S when seq_len >= 8192 and batch >= 8. attaching quick notes.

maria: ugh ok — is this kv-cache related or pure kernel choice?

alex: kv-cache enabled in all runs. baseline (paged-attn) p99 ~42ms at 4096/8. at 8192/8 hybrid-tiling selector picks fused-tiling variant -> p99 jumps to ~310ms, throughput drops ~3x.

kevin: can you drop the exact command you used?

alex: sure:
```
./run_bench --model llama2-13b --kernel-selector hybrid --device L40S --seq-len 8192 --batch 8 --kv-cache true --warmups 200 --iters 2000
```

alex: nvprof summary (trimmed):
```
GPU memcpy HtoD: 0.412s (spikes during cache refill)
Kernel __flash_attention_fused: 0.021s
Kernel hybrid_tail_tile: 0.672s  <-- dominates p99
Kernel fallback_unrolled: 0.301s
```

maria: so hybrid_tail_tile is killing us. does it allocate large temporaries for KV merging?

alex: yes looks like register pressure + L2 thrash. Nsight trace shows frequent device-to-device memcpy between tile buffers while evicting/merging KV pages. When batch grows, multiple streams contend and memcpy blocks host.

kevin: interesting that A100 doesn't show as bad?

alex: right — on A100 the same run has p99 ~78ms. H100 is ~65ms. only L40S shows dramatic tailspike. likely different L2/cache and memset bandwidths.

infra-bot: ci-benchmarks/1771002222: run finished. artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/1771002222/trace.nsv, nvprof.log

chris: any recent changes to selector thresholds? iirc we loosened fallback to fused for sequences >6k in commit 3f4aab.

maria: @chris yep that commit inverted a heuristic: we now prefer fused/hybrid for moderate batch sizes because it was faster on H100. but L40S behaves differently.

kevin: can we add a device-specific override? e.g., prefer paged-attn for L40S if seq_len >= 6144 or if kv_cache enabled and batch >= 4?

alex: quick patch I tested locally: force paged-attn on L40S for seq_len >= 6144 -> p99 back to ~48ms, throughput recovers.

chris: sounds like we need selector to consult two signals: device micro-arch + kv_cache_enabled + estimated mem_spill_cost. current selector only considers static seq and batch costs.

maria: also saw a KV cache eviction hotspot: merging pages causes synchronous memcpy when mempool fragmentation high. maybe we should pre-reserve merge buffers for hybrid path.

kevin: low-effort mitigation: change threshold in selector for L40S (roll back 3f4aab for L40S only) + add a CI bench that sweeps kv_cache=true combos for L40S.

alex: i ran a minimal repro that toggles kv_cache:
```
# RESULTS (L40S, seq=8192, batch=8)
kv_cache=true  p99=310ms
kv_cache=false p99=52ms
```

chris: who can own a short PR to add device-aware override + test? this needs to go into the next minor release.

maria: i'll take the PR to gate the selector with device checks and add a unit test that simulates mem_spill estimation.

kevin: i'll add the CI benchmark entry and upload the nvprof trace to the perf dash. also add a regression alert for p99>200ms on L40S seq>=8192.

alex: flagged the offending commit in our bisect notes: 3f4aab -> logic flip in kernel_selector.cpp line ~412. looks like a simple conditional inversion.

chris: thanks. after PR, we should also consider: 1) pre-alloc merge buffers for hybrid to avoid host-sync memcpys, 2) tighter batching heuristic when kv_cache=true to avoid multi-stream contention.

maria: noted. i'll prototype prealloc in a follow-up — might need allocator change.

sre-bot: incident-template: performance_regression L40S seq>=8192 p99 spike. assigned: @maria, @kevin. ETA: 24h for patch, 72h for rollout.

alex: next steps: maria PR to revert-for-L40S selector + tests; kevin CI bench + upload traces; follow-up task for allocator prealloc. I'll include the nvprof excerpt in the PR.

kevin: uploading artifacts now -> s3://redwood-bench/1771002222/ (trace, nvprof.log, perf.csv)

maria: starting work now. will post link to PR when draft ready. :thumbsup:

alex: huge help — thanks team.

chris: once PR lands, run full sweep (A100/H100/L40S) and add comparison plot for seq sweep [1024, 2048, 4096, 6144, 8192] x batch [1,2,4,8]. link it to the rollout checklist.

kevin: agreed. i'll script the plotting and add to perf dash.

sre-bot: note: schedule canary on dedicated pool that contains L40S nodes only, to validate in-prod impact.

alex: ok closing thread, will follow up in PR comments.
